remarks: Spacious Glenbrook townhouse with an attached 1-car garage, wired for an EV charger! Set at the quiet end of the small complex, this thoughtfully designed unit has three levels of finished living space. The main level has an effortless flow and connection between the inviting living room, dining area, and kitchen. A convenient powder room completes this level, making it ideal for entertaining. The upper level features two generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The lower level makes for a great family room, office, or exercise room. Throughout the home, you'll find abundant storage space, ensuring everything has its place. Recent improvements include new HVAC in 2022, new range and new dishwasher. This townhouse provides easy access to the Glenbrook train station, as well as an array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
